ratings.reason: This is an unusually clean, explicit instance: every generated output is uniformly capped at line-sketch fidelity and one-line text specifically so users supply interpretation and specificity. The mechanism is concrete and readily transferable to other creative domains. It is more consequential and interesting than merely adopting a sketch aesthetic because withholding finish is an articulated creativity-support strategy. Impact is held at 4 because the supplied evidence establishes the design rationale but not measured outcome changes.

Converting finished AI designs into lower-fidelity sketch scaffolds fits the core rendering-ceiling move and plausibly reserves elaboration for the user. However, the very short evidence does not establish whether low fidelity is imposed uniformly, whether users can request higher fidelity, or exactly how they fill the scaffold. Analogical sketching suggests useful exploration, but impact and novelty cannot be confidently inferred from the title and fragment alone.

The deliberate removal of titles, authors, and full quotations is a clear and interesting withholding mechanism that invites users to construct personal meaning. But it weakly matches this pattern’s structural signature: the output is decontextualized rather than rendered as a low-detail scaffold for the user to complete into a more specific artifact. It therefore sits closer to ambiguity or context-removal for reflection. The quote supports that neighboring mechanism well, but not a fidelity ceiling, so representativeness and evidence strength for pat-072 are low.
